paper.title: Growing scale-free networks with tunable clustering

headline: Holme-Kim 2002: 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; average C(p=1)=0.617, gamma stable, but P3 misses because L(p=1,N=1000)=4.154 exceeds the locked <=4.0 bar

verdicts.gate: P1 tunable clustering: average local C(p=1)>=0.40, C(p=1)/C(p=0)>=5, and C(0)<C(0.45)<C(1)
P2 scale-free preserved: gamma_fit(p=0) and gamma_fit(p=1) both in [2.0,3.5], with absolute difference <=0.4
P3 small-world path length: L(1000) in [3,4], L(5000) in [3.5,5], and growth <=1 for p in {0,1}

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published network-generation / mildly agent-based model; no real-world data; P1 uses average local clustering and reports transitivity separately

citations: Holme, P. & Kim, B.J. (2002). Growing scale-free networks with tunable clustering. Physical Review E 65:026107. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.65.026107.

benchmark.note: networkx powerlaw_cluster_graph is used in unit tests as an independent same-algorithm clustering-regime cross-check
